top_choice_rationale: Sequencing by synthesis rests on a clear chemical principle (reversible-terminator nucleotides read out on clustered single-molecule templates) that turned a stepwise reaction into a massively parallel digital readout, with quantitative evidence of impact and two decades of maturity. The Balasubramanian and Klenerman allocation is the least contested core of the field, and the citation can be explained to a broad audience; it opens vast new capabilities in the sense of unforeseen opportunities. P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig C-N coupling) is a mature, defensible second choice, but its original discovery, attribution (Kosugi omitted) and impact are somewhat narrower in scope. No award is the least preferred, since mature prize-worthy work is available.
